$comment: Machine-readable upstream metadata. Human guide: UPSTREAM.md. Updated by .github/workflows/upstream-sync.yml (sha.fetched/integrated) — never edit sha.pinned.

sync.cadence: 매주 월요일 00:00 UTC (09:00 KST) 예약 실행 + workflow_dispatch 수동 실행
sync.identity: deploy key "upstream-sync" (secret UPSTREAM_SYNC_SSH_KEY); fallback GITHUB_TOKEN with warning
sync.mergeStrategy: merge commit only (squash/rebase disabled at repository level)

role.reason: EventCatalog OSS core 그 자체. packages/core(@eventcatalog/core + eventcatalog CLI), sdk, create-eventcatalog, visualiser, cli, linter, connectors, breaking-changes를 모두 포함하는 monorepo. examples/default 샘플 카탈로그로 clean build/run이 가능하며, 다른 GitHub 저장소 checkout이 필요 없다(모든 패키지 간 의존은 workspace:*, registry 외 의존 없음).

commercialPaths: 위 경로에서 파생된 빌드 산출물(packages/core/dist/**, bin/** 포함)
licenseBoundary.productionRestriction: commercial 경로에 한함(EventCatalog Commercial License: development/testing 목적 copy·modify 허용, production 사용은 Starter/Scale/Enterprise 구독 필요, license key 기능 우회 금지)
licenseBoundary.ossOnlyPolicy: license key 미설정(community edition 경로)으로만 빌드·실행. enterprise/federation 기능 활성화 금지.

build.run: pnpm run start:catalog  # dev 서버 http://localhost:3000 (examples/default). 정적 산출물 서빙: npx serve@14 examples/default/dist
build.smoke: static: npx serve@14 examples/default/dist 후 GET /, /discover/events, /docs/domains/payments, /visualiser/system-context-map, /llms.txt → 200, 홈에 'Acme Inc'; SSR: pnpm pack(sdk/core/linter/connectors/visualiser) → examples/ssr에 npm install → npx eventcatalog build → node packages/core/scripts/ci/smoke-ssr.mjs examples/ssr

upstreamWorkflows.triggers: workflow_dispatch, or release published whose tag starts with @eventcatalog/core@
workflow_run of workflow 'Release' completed, when conclusion == success and head commit message starts with 'Version Packages'

main: required review 1 (admin bypass for PR merge)
vendor/upstream-main: updates only by sync identity (deploy key)
protection.note: GitHub rulesets on public repos (Free plan). appliedAt is filled when rulesets are active.
